# App bar

The top of a product: brand, navigation and settings; sticky without covering focus.

- Status: implemented
- Category: navigation
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “landmarks”; HTML `<header> banner`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **brand**: The mark and the wordmark, a link home.
- **navigation** (optional): Primary destinations.
- **actions** (optional): Theme, language, motion settings.

## Variants

- `site`: The site header.
- `app`: A desktop or mobile app's top bar.

## States

- `default`
- `scrolled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Through its controls. |

## Accessibility

- Role: banner
- A sticky bar sets scroll-padding so a focused element is never hidden under it (2.4.11).
- Sticky positioning is opt-in; the product sets --sticky-offset to the actual bar height, including reflow.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (A)
- 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA)
- 1.4.10 Reflow (AA)

## Contrast

Each pair meets its ratio in every theme and direction (checked on every build).

| Foreground | Background | Minimum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app-bar.text` | `app-bar.fill` | 4.5:1 |

Web: `.nd-app-bar` in kit.css; modifiers `.app`, `.sticky`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <header class="nd-app-bar">
    <a class="nd-app-bar__brand" href="#main">NDDev</a>
    <nav class="nd-navigation" aria-label="Example app destinations">
      <ul role="list">
        <li>
          <a href="#component-app-bar" aria-current="page">Workspace</a>
        </li>
        <li><a href="#component-list">Library</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
    <div class="nd-app-bar__actions">
      <button class="nd-button nd-button--quiet" type="button">
        Settings
      </button>
    </div>
  </header>
  <header class="nd-app-bar nd-app-bar--app" data-scrolled="true">
    <a class="nd-app-bar__brand" href="#main">Project</a>
    <div class="nd-app-bar__actions">
      <button class="nd-button nd-button--quiet" type="button">Search</button>
    </div>
  </header>
</div>
```
